cases.title: Missing offline acknowledgement refuses new predicate before any change
Backend prerequisite must exist; the session candidate cannot install an incomplete gate
Actual no-argument session functions compile without changing prior public routines, RLS or triggers
Existing predicate names or overloads are never overwritten by a second candidate installation
Only authenticated can execute the two public wrappers; all API roles lack the private helper
Password-only ordinary and platform Admin sessions both fail without stored verification
Forged email-verified, AAL2, Admin-role and remembered-until claims do not create a proof
Proof established by the actual service challenge/verify SQL authorizes only its exact session
Foreign-account session substitution and nonexistent session are denied
Missing, malformed, wrong-type and null request claims safely return false
Expired, missing, string, fractional, oversized and negative JWT expiry are denied
Service/anonymous token roles cannot become a user proof through the callable wrapper
Conflicting legacy Auth sub/role settings cannot borrow a valid proof
Assertion returns a fixed permission denial for an unverified session and accepts the verified one
A restrictive policy on actual profiles denies password-only reads while preserving existing owner rules
A guarded definer still checks the request session and keeps an independent target-ownership check
A platform Admin gets the same verification gate, then retains only its existing Admin authorization
Day-seven device expiry does not expire an open approved session or approve a fresh session
Real session timebox invalidates an existing proof and restoring the timebox preserves other checks
Security-version mismatch denies a stored proof without trusting client verification flags
Password changes invalidate the current proof without changing another approved account
Profile suspension invalidates proof, and reactivation does not revive it
Deleting the real modeled Auth session cascades its proof and leaves another account approved
Application policies and synthetic definer used for integration are removed before final metadata comparison
